notes.title: My Heaven's Dale - Demo Big Update
notes.content:
Hello! I decided to update the demo taking into account some player's feedback! 


Here's the news:

Interactive tutorials with NPC's for:
Feed and animal caring.

Planting Crops and Watering.

Using the Axe and Stocking Wood.

Sending items through the Shipping Box

Fishing


Major Changes:
Day length increase from 15m to 25m.

It's now possible to complete the rocket quest in just 2 days.

Added new interiors to some locations

New quest hint system via inventory.

Rewritten NPC dialogues.

Added new details to some maps.

notes.title: Content Update - My Heaven's Dale
notes.content:
First of all, I would like to thank all of you who added the game to your wishlist! We have now surpassed the great milestone of 2,200!

Today I wanted to show you some things I have been doing since the demo was published:


Moon Fragments.

 The old "SweetBerries" have been changed to "Lunar Fragments", and will give the player a great reward when they find and collect 8 of them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603762/5d7e39049c54efb6c9ab95064db4bb8ab640121d.jpg

GreenHouse

 You can build a GreenHouse next to your ranch to get a huge spot with 216 seed plots, compared to the 24 plots next to your house, that's a huge increase!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603762/3eef9a85d868393da56c95c1f27899d6d50210cb.jpg

Moon Portals

 You can unlock portals to quickly travel between planets!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603762/0b7222d10309e3e6a5285ee56ac4ef9026b36d30.jpg

Beach Boat

 You can repair the beach boat to go to a new island!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603762/4c191e57c0356b3d78c5d4bda4c5475e34a01b16.png

Icon Bubbles

 Icons will float in commission boxes to save you from having to interact every time you want to see what's the commission for the day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603762/0e96fa6c7927df234b62d953737b8344c9bdef0d.png

Many other things have been worked on like quests and dialogue rewriting, but that's the main thing for now!

notes.title: My Heaven's Dale Demo is out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603762/714664890bc6f29649553739b744e6cca6cc4760.png

Demo Steam Page!

This demo will present a summary of the first chapter of the story, mechanics, animals, characters and the map to explore.

Many features will be limited to ensure that the release version is truly valuable, I still intend to keep it in development throughout 2025, there is a lot to work on, but you can get a little taste of it through this demo version, enjoy!
=========================================



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603762/1aa495fbb705f7960ea3473c7f8ebb9d1e250b18.png



 New Friendship, Romance, Marriage and Children systems.
 New NPC's Heart events to increase character depth.
 New Animals available for purchase, including goats.
 More Floors in the mines with many more gems to collect.
 New Caves to explore (at the moon).
 New Achievement rooms to complete.
 New Story chapters involving the Moon.
 New Maps of the Moon to explore and do story-missions
 New Maps of Heaven's Dale, beyond the river.
 New Seasonal content that changes with the season.
 New Seeds to plant.
 New Special animals to obtain.
 New Tables for your Carpenter's Shop.
 New Barrels for your Carpenter's Shop (downstairs)
 New Animal friendship system.
 New Stores available.
 New Special Characters.


And more! My Heaven's Dale a project that I'm developing alone in my free time, I'm learning daily and thinking more and more about better ideas to add and keep you engaged, ahem, taking into account what I can do at the moment! 🙂
